title: Autoantibodies on Spinal Cord Injury
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine the autoantibody profiles after spinal cord injury and their role in spontaneous functional recovery.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Traumatic or non-progressive vascular SCI
* Less than 45 days after lesion
* Any neurological level
* Complete and incomplete lesions
* If patient has been treated with glucocorticoids, it should have passed at least 7 days from the end of the treatment

Exclusion Criteria:

* Cauda equina syndrome
* Autoimmune disorder
* Tumor (even if benign)
* Neurodegenerative disease
study_population: Patients with acute spinal cord injury admitted to the Spanish National Hospital for Paraplegics
